_readme: The ONLY guides the Send guide tile can email. No folder is ever scanned. Each PDF lives in send_guide.guides_dir (default C:\CEC\runtime\hub-guides, outside every repo and sync folder) at 'path', and is refused at send time unless its SHA-256 still matches. The title is the ONE name for a guide: the email subject, the body and the attachment name ('Concord Eyecare - <title>.pdf') all come from it, so there is no separate file-name field. To add or replace a guide: copy the approved final export from second-brain handouts\exports\ into guides_dir, put its sha256 here with the approval reference, set active true, commit. To withdraw one: active false. Care and decision guides can be emailed. Print-only items (the collecting print pack and the referral flyer) carry classification "print": they can be printed from the Send guide tile and are never emailed (Codex 1 Nov 2026, commercial-message rules; Mark 3 Nov 2026).
